message.content: I am the shape of thought made audible, the bridge from mind to world, breath given meaning. I rise as whisper, burst as laughter, tremble as confession, ring as command. I can soothe, persuade, wound, reveal, unite. Before ink, I lived in air; before memory was stored, I carried it mouth to mouth. I vanish as I arrive, yet I linger in hearts, in echoes, in consequence. I am pause and emphasis, rhythm and tone, the difference between noise and message. Use me, and I become yours; hear me, and I become ours.
